selection_metric_primary: lowest validation review_adjusted_cost with review_cost=0.5, FN=5, FP=1
selection_metric_secondary: manual_review_rate<=0.25 preferred, then high_risk_precision, low_risk_default_rate, auto_decision_rate
selection_reason: Locked manual-review policy because corrected validation review-adjusted cost and operational workload favor Best Scorecard. Binary winner is SCRE-Optimized with validation binary cost=853.0; binary and manual-review costs are reported separately. Scorecard remains interpretable benchmark when applicable.
manual_review_cost_assumption: review_adjusted_cost = auto_FP*fp_cost + auto_FN*fn_cost + manual_review_count*review_cost; manual decisions assumed correct for Track 2 selection
